title: Cross-Device Continuity Manager — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Transfers compatible application state and task progress between devices. A proposed manager for the multi-device life: it transfers compatible application state and task progress between devices — start a draft on the phone, continue on the laptop, review on the tablet — keeping everything in sync and secure, and telling the user exactly what moved where.
